address: 36 Nguyen Ba Huan Street, An Khanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 70000, Vietnam
bio: This newcomer to HCMC’s bistro scene greets diners with a cosy dining room that offers both counter and table seating. The theatrical open kitchen is where the alchemy takes place. The menu consists of modern dishes inspired by the chef’s childhood memories and Vietnamese food culture, including cheese and noodles made from scratch in-house. The wine list features a wide range of wines by the glass, covering organic, biodynamic and natural tipples....
